articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Happy Birthday to Lamine Yamal, and the World Cup itself
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition as we now know our four World Cup semifinalists.

articles.headline: France counterattack, Argentina set pieces: How World Cup semifinalists score goals
articles.description: We're down to the final four of the World Cup, with the four top-ranked teams set to square off. Yet all of them use very different attacking styles in order to score goals; let's break it down.

articles.headline: Argentina scouting report: How can England stop Lionel Messi and co. in the World Cup semfinal?
articles.description: ESPN Argentina's Nico Baier provides the lowdown on England's World Cup semifinal opponents.

articles.headline: Police investigating death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams
articles.description: Police said Monday they are investigating the death of South Africa World Cup football player Jayden Adams, after his body was discovered this weekend at a property in the city of Cape Town.

articles.headline: Pau Cubarsí calls for tolerance after Spain's ex-PM questions nationality of France players
articles.description: Spain defender Pau Cubarsí has called for tolerance after the nation's former Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, claimed that France "don't have any French players."

articles.headline: Slaven Bilić returns for second stint as Croatia head coach
articles.description: Slaven Bilić has been appointed as the new head coach of Croatia.
